## Changes

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Include Closes #N or Refs #N when applicable.

## Validation

List checks and results, including any unverified work.

## Changelog

Add one unique `changelog.d/<issue-or-slug>.md` fragment. Preserve entry formatting
and issue/PR references. Never edit Unreleased directly. Release PRs assemble
fragments with `npm run version:set -- <x.y.z>`; see [the fragment guide](../changelog.d/README.md).
